name: Princes Group plc
summary: Princes Group plc operates as a food and beverage company in the United Kingdom, Italy, Germany, and internationally. The company operates through Foods, Fish, Italian, Oils, and Drinks segments. It offers food, soft drinks, and edible oils. The company also provides oils, including seed, olive, and speciality oils, and compound fat pasta; beverages, such as fruit juices, sparkling and flavoured soft drinks, and ready-to-drink formats; ready meals; home baking products; fish and bakery products; canned food; and tomato products.
